lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\TutaMail\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
3 classes in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\TutaMail, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
lib/Controller/ProxyController.php:238 OCA\TutaMail\Controller\PreflightException, by its path OCA\TutaMail\Controller\ProxyController
lib/Controller/ProxyController.php:248 OCA\TutaMail\Controller\ForbiddenProxyPathException, by its path OCA\TutaMail\Controller\ProxyController
lib/Controller/ProxyController.php:256 OCA\TutaMail\Controller\ForbiddenOriginException, by its path OCA\TutaMail\Controller\ProxyController

Nothing in the app calls 1 route outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
GET /index.php/apps/tutamail/{path}  tutamail.page.spafallback  appinfo/routes.php:39 routes

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

Nothing in the app calls 4 routes outside OCS whose method allows requests from other origins (CORS), or that answer the preflight of such a request (OPTIONS). They are there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.

Nothing in the app calls 1 OCS route. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/tutamail/api/v1/version  ocs.tutamail.inapp.version  lib/Controller/InAppController.php:25
The app has 1 OCS route and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
